newsitem.title: USA: NYS property tax relief likely to be rebate--paper.
newsitem.headline: NYS property tax relief likely to be rebate--paper.

text.p: Delays in New York State's budget make it unlikely that a plan will be reached in time for it to take effect in September, so rebates might be used instead of tax cuts, the Daily Gazette said Friday.

A final agreement on cutting school property taxes probably will not come quickly enough for state and local officals to recalculate and adjust tax bills by September, the paper said, citing a spokesman for the state Division of Budget.

Gov George Pataki and the Senate have put forward different school tax relief proposals and the Assembly, which has yet to vote on a plan, has suggested no action might be taken until a thorny battle over rent rules, which expire on June 15, was solved. The fight over apartment rent regulations also has held up the state budget, which was due on April 1.
